g.text: PWR_OK 5V -> R2 10k / R3 20k -> 3.3 V -> GPIO5. DS18B20 x2 on GPIO7 (R4). FAN TACH -> R6 10k -> GPIO11.

g.desc: PWR_OK 5V -> R2 10k / R3 20k -> 3.3 V -> GPIO5. DS18B20 x2 on GPIO7 (R4). FAN TACH -> R6 10k -> GPIO11.

g.text: PSU ATX 24-pin plug -> J1. 5VSB -> DevKit 5V pin (its own LDO makes 3V3). 12V only feeds the fan header.

g.desc: PSU ATX 24-pin plug -> J1. 5VSB -> DevKit 5V pin (its own LDO makes 3V3). 12V only feeds the fan header.

g.text: Q1 pulls PS_ON low (PSU ON) while GPIO4 is HIGH or floating (R1 pull-up) -> PSU stays on when the ESP32 is dead.

g.desc: Q1 pulls PS_ON low (PSU ON) while GPIO4 is HIGH or floating (R1 pull-up) -> PSU stays on when the ESP32 is dead.

g.text: GPIO4 LOW -> PSU off. Same polarity as the relay-module wiring: keep relay_inverted: "true" in the yaml.

g.desc: GPIO4 LOW -> PSU off. Same polarity as the relay-module wiring: keep relay_inverted: "true" in the yaml.

g.text: J7 5V pin is fed through D2 (~4.3 V) so a 3.3 V data line is a valid HIGH for a WS2812B. J2 = ST7789 via wires.

g.desc: J7 5V pin is fed through D2 (~4.3 V) so a 3.3 V data line is a valid HIGH for a WS2812B. J2 = ST7789 via wires.
